 JioStar secures Abu Dhabi T10 broadcast rights for Indian subcontinent
 The partnership follows ADCSH taking majority ownership and commercial rights of the tournament, with India and the wider subcontinent among its biggest international audiences.
 afaqs! news bureau 
 26 Oct 2026 
 16:42
 IST Follow Us
 New Update JioStar has secured the broadcast rights for the 2026 Abu Dhabi T10 in the Indian subcontinent. All 32 matches will be broadcast on Star Sports and streamed on JioHotstar.
 The partnership comes after Abu Dhabi Cricket & Sports Hub (ADCSH) took majority ownership and commercial rights of the tournament earlier this year. India and the wider subcontinent have been among the Abu Dhabi T10's largest international audiences.
 Matt Boucher, ADCSH’s Chief Executive Officer and CEO of Abu Dhabi T10, said: “This partnership represents a special moment in the continued evolution of the Abu Dhabi T10. India has always been our biggest and most passionate market and collaborating with JioStar enables us to connect with an even broader audience through platforms renowned for delivering world-class cricket coverage.
 “As we continue building the tournament’s next growth chapter under Abu Dhabi’s stewardship, expanding our broadcast footprint is central to our long-term strategy. We are committed to establishing the Abu Dhabi T10 as a leading sporting and entertainment product, and this partnership gives us an exceptional platform to inspire new fans while strengthening our connection with existing audiences across India and the subcontinent.”
 Prashant Khanna, head- Sports: Rights & Innovation, JioStar, said: “T10 has found its audience in India for its mile-a-minute format, and we are excited to bring that same energy to the Abu Dhabi T10. In a market that lives and breathes cricket like no other, JioStar’s unparalleled reach can take the event far and wide while pulling in a whole new set of fans along the way.”
 JioStar will also support the tournament with additional content and digital initiatives, including exclusive content, behind-the-scenes access and digital features.
 The 2026 Abu Dhabi T10 will be held from November 7 to 20 at Zayed Cricket Stadium in Abu Dhabi. The tournament will feature 32 matches across 13 playing days, including six triple-header and seven double-header days.
 The Official Player Draft was held in Abu Dhabi on September 30, with international players selected for the tournament.
 The 2025 edition recorded more than 527 million social media impressions and US$512 million in broadcast value, according to the tournament.
 “The partnership with JioStar is expected to significantly increase audience engagement in India while reinforcing the Abu Dhabi T10's position as a leading global cricket property. By combining elite international talent with world-class broadcast production, multilingual coverage and enhanced broadcast storytelling, the tournament is poised to reach its largest audience yet while further cementing Abu Dhabi's reputation as the global home of cricket's fastest format,” added Matt Boucher.
